text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B, E, and C for gains felt satisfying, but a gain versus my average cost alone does not show whether selling was the best choice.","My account value fell in some periods and rose in others; with prices moving randomly, I should not treat recent changes as reliable predictions.","I check and trade often, so I should pause before acting and make each decision deliberately rather than trade just to lock in a gain or avoid realizing a loss."]}
